exposure: Mode of vaginal delivery (spontaneous, vacuum, forceps)
cohort: 13,694 women aged 20 years or older living in Norway who had a history of vaginal birth.
finding: Among women younger than 50 years, forceps delivery was associated with a significant increased long-term risk of stress urinary incontinence compared with spontaneous vaginal delivery and vacuum delivery.
mod_finding: Forceps delivery was associated with a significant increased long-term risk of stress urinary incontinence compared to other vaginal delivery methods in women younger than 50.
followup_time: Not mentioned, but study focused on women 'aged 20 years or older'
